title: AsPluginManager
description: Search, install, update and uninstall Modrinth plugins directly from inside Minecraft.
body:
# ⚡ AsPluginManager ### Install Plugins Without Leaving Minecraft **by ItzAzeem | AsDevs** [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-Join%20Us-5865F2?logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/xRW5rdAvs5) [![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/v1.0.0-BETA-brightgreen)](https://modrinth.com) [![Minecraft](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.21+-orange)](https://papermc.io/) [![Paper](https://img.shields.io/badge/Paper-Supported-blue)](https://papermc.io/) [![Modrinth](https://img.shields.io/badge/Source-Modrinth-00AF5C)](https://modrinth.com) ### 🚀 Search, Install, Update & Uninstall Plugins Directly From Minecraft No browser. No file manager. No FTP. Manage your server plugins with simple commands directly from in-game chat.
--- # ✨ Features ### 🔍 Search Plugins Search Modrinth without leaving Minecraft. ```text /pm search ``` Example: ```text /pm search economy /pm search hologram /pm search permissions ``` --- ### 📦 Install Plugins Install plugins directly from Modrinth. ```text /pm install ``` Example: ```text /pm install luckperms /pm install viaversion /pm install chunky ``` AsPluginManager automatically: - Detects your Minecraft version - Detects Paper/Purpur compatibility - Finds the best matching release - Downloads the plugin - Loads it automatically when supported --- ### 🔄 Update Plugins Keep plugins up to date. ```text /pm update ``` Example: ```text /pm update luckperms ``` --- ### 🗑️ Uninstall Plugins Remove plugins directly from your server. ```text /pm uninstall ``` --- ### ⚙️ Smart Compatibility Detection AsPluginManager automatically detects: - Minecraft Version - Paper - Purpur - Spigot - Bukkit-compatible releases and installs the most suitable version available. --- ### ⚡ Dynamic Plugin Loading Many plugins can be loaded instantly without restarting the server. Successfully tested with: ✅ LuckPerms ✅ ViaVersion ✅ ViaBackwards ✅ SkinsRestorer ✅ spark ✅ TAB ✅ Chunky ✅ Simple Voice Chat Some plugins may still require a restart depending on how they are designed. --- # 📜 Commands ```text /pm search /pm install /pm update /pm uninstall /pm reload ``` --- # 🎥 Showcase Video Watch AsPluginManager : --- # 👨‍💻 Developer **ItzAzeem** Made with ❤️ for Minecraft server owners. --- # 💬 Support Need help, found a bug, or want to suggest a feature? Join our Discord community: https://discord.gg/xRW5rdAvs5 --- ⭐ If AsPluginManager saves you time, consider leaving a follow on Modrinth!
